build.environment: Ubuntu 24.04, TeX Live 2023, pdfTeX 1.40.25, latexmk 4.83, Poppler
build.result: Built without LaTeX or layout warnings. The rendered edition was visually checked.

endpoint_minima.result: Five million four hundred seventy-five thousand two hundred eight minima through dimension 200, including 2,145 ordinary-forcing signatures. All 1,188 dimension-30 minima and a brute endpoint test on 401 signatures through dimension 20 agree.

full_historical_counts.result: An integral-breakpoint enumeration independently reproduces all 1,188 historical rows, including the 8,073,364 candidate and 3,846,011 surviving polygon multiplicities and the minimum p-ranks.

moment_covers.result: The former replays three rational residues, the split p=19 case, and 69 bounded branch multisets across 20 combinations. The latter checks the split nonordinary p=73 selection and connected-conductor examples at 37 in orders 342, 12,663 and 468,540.

pdf_only_internal_review.context: The compiled PDF and five reader prompts only.
findings: Recovered the simultaneous norm theorem, fixed-endpoint polygon, closed minimum, complete numerical classification and linked projective-monodromy theorem.
Reconstructed the strict norm argument, half-weighted midpoint and endpoint-slot assignment, and Galois-stable linkage proof.
Identified the quaternionic polarization and Hodge commutant as the most compressed steps and checked the argument.
Distinguished numerical sharpness, prime-field examples varying with the prime and the finite-extension density results for fixed varieties.
Found two typesetting errors and a missing proof-navigation step for the two rank corollaries. Independently reproduced the selected coefficient calculations at 73 and 37.
pdf_only_internal_review.disposition: Restored both explicit corollary proofs, corrected both displays, and clarified the quaternionic and Hodge steps, the Hasse coefficient extraction and the companion census.

remaining: Density-one ordinary reduction in the independent projective monodromy cases with three balanced pairs.
External specialist review and priority for the oriented extremal polygon, closed minimum, projective linkage criterion and moment applications.
